text: FIX the relaxed selector syntax of the database viewer kept the escapes `\\` and `\"` literally inside single quoted strings, so `{ name: { $regex: '^\\d+$' } }` matched different documents than the same selector with double quotes. Single quoted strings now resolve `\\`, `\'` and `\"`. Any other backslash, like in `{ name: { $regex: '\bLearn\d+' } }`, stays a literal backslash, so a regex works as typed.
